Ask who you wish to become. Then ask how your habits are casting votes for that person.

Study 20 minutes on Tuesday night and you cast a vote for being studious. Shoot a basketball for an hour and you cast a vote for being a basketball player.

Do that for three or six months and you cross a threshold where it becomes part of your story. Then you fight to keep the habit. You go for a run because you're a runner, not because you have a half marathon in three months.

How long a habit takes to stick varies widely - weeks to a year - and the habit - identity link is mostly correlational.

- Then a long extended exhale through the mouth
